basic_info.description: Ideally positioned on the top floor of a two-unit building, 250 2nd Ave boasts two bedrooms, one bath, and approx. 1,460 sqft. Details include beautiful oak hardwood floors, 10'4'' ceilings, original period details, and incredible natural light throughout with windows on all four sides. The gracious living room, featuring a gas stove fireplace, built-in shelving, and a bay window, seamlessly flows through an arched doorway to the perfectly designed dining room that includes a contemporary white oak built-in sideboard. The kitchen has been thoughtfully remodeled with shaker-style cabinetry, stainless steel appliances, and quartz counters and steps out to one of the two private decks; the perfect place to BBQ or enjoy alfresco dining. Down the hall is the office alcove with an oversized window; providing the ideal work-from-home set up. The primary bedroom is located in the rear of the unit and enjoys a large walk-out ipe deck overlooking the garden below and Sutro Tower in the distance. Adjacent is the spacious full bath with a rainfall showerhead. The secondary bedroom is positioned at the front of the unit, creating great separation. The unit includes 1 car parking, additional storage, a shared garden, and common laundry.
